concept_name: Complete authority universe versus bounded active selection
irreducible_obligation: A bounded active registry/selection must never be mistaken for the complete semantic-authority universe; absence from a bounded surface cannot erase separately certified authority.
trii_destination: Route-A compiler must ingest complete governed authority before carrier-backed C11/I03/I05/I04; bounded selections may override but not define universe.
chetiri_destination: Virtual/hybrid compiler must assemble the same complete governed authority envelope before on-demand execution; source access cannot substitute for missing semantic capital.
required_proof_or_action: Field-level crosswalk from historical P2/P3/P3C/response/QSM/QUC authority universe to current Trii and Chetiri inputs.

concept_name: Authority precedence and stage-local contract drift prevention
irreducible_obligation: Later producers/validators/adapters may not silently reinterpret, downgrade, or clear authority established by a higher/earlier governed source; compiler and validator must share one canonical resolution law.
trii_destination: Persistent-substrate build and all downstream validators must use one precedence/resolution contract and preserve provenance of the winning authority.
chetiri_destination: Virtual/hybrid execution and validators must use the identical precedence/resolution contract on every recomputation; no route-local heuristic backfill.
required_proof_or_action: Enumerate precedence order across source-native evidence, manual authority, bounded overrides, negative authority, QSM/QRA/QSMv2/FQRA, response semantics, and route-specific derived state.

irreducible_obligation: No-evidence, not-applicable, review-only, unresolved, blocked, malformed, and ready are distinct governed states; zero rows or empty lanes cannot be collapsed into failure or readiness.
trii_destination: Persistent products must encode typed negative/terminal states and preserve them through carrier, C11, I03/I05/I04, rebuild, and cache invalidation.
chetiri_destination: Virtual/hybrid execution must deterministically reproduce the same typed states on demand and preserve them in any caches/publications.
required_proof_or_action: Crosswalk historical terminal vocabularies to current C11/I03/I05/I04 and structural-publication statuses; prohibit semantic collapse.

irreducible_obligation: Question kind, structural role, source matching, child topology, access pattern/expression, manual-review state, driver fields, and handling rules are compiler knowledge not derivable merely from raw values.
trii_destination: Route A must bind recovered/canonical question-structure authority into the persistent-substrate/compiler build without regenerating manual judgments from source heuristics.
chetiri_destination: Route B/C must load or lawfully derive from preserved governed sidecars the same question-structure knowledge before source-native computation.
required_proof_or_action: Install/provenance-bind exact 18,792-row register; reconcile later 18,518-row FQRA/QSM universe; recover or retire row-level source-structure replay inputs with proof.

irreducible_obligation: Not asked, not in risk set, routing-inapplicable, semantically inapplicable, unresolved predicate, missing response, neutral, and opposed must remain distinct; routing predicates may not be inferred from column existence or empirical co-occurrence.
trii_destination: Persistent substrate must preserve complete risk sets/routing states or exact governed information sufficient to reconstruct them; unresolved predicates remain explicit blockers.
chetiri_destination: Virtual/hybrid accessor must compile exact routing/applicability predicates from source + authority at execution time; unresolved predicates remain explicit blockers.
required_proof_or_action: Reconcile the 18,518-item applicability authority and explicit unresolved predicate classes into common C11/I03 truth conditions.

irreducible_obligation: Raw option labels/codes, substantive answer status, signed response direction/intensity, context/admin response states, missing states, and semantic certification are distinct; contract coverage status outranks naive row-level nonblankness.
trii_destination: Route A must compile/persist exact response states and signed semantics only where governed; quarantine legacy inference and preserve manual authority hashes.
chetiri_destination: Route B/C must resolve source-native response codes against identical governed response contracts on demand; no code-order/text inference may manufacture polarity.
required_proof_or_action: Reconcile 236 certified active scales, 464 context/admin contracts, family response-option packets, alias authority, and current V551 binding into one shared response-semantics contract.

trii_destination: Carrier build must bind exact raw identifiers to governed semantic identities and record alias provenance before semantic projection.
chetiri_destination: Source-native accessor must apply identical alias authority before QSM/QUC and response-semantic lookup on every execution.

trii_destination: Route A structural/discovery compilation must consume canonical proposition identity as preserved semantic authority separate from physical respondent evidence.
chetiri_destination: Route B/C must consume the same canonical proposition identity sidecars; recomputation from source wording/statistics is not an allowed replacement for adjudicated identity.
required_proof_or_action: Prove lossless succession/installation of R184 exports into present PRE553 authority surfaces; separately decide which P3/P3A authority-production lifecycle capabilities remain needed for future onboarding.

irreducible_obligation: A logical source-native configuration is distinct from an executable scope variant; configuration type, members, roles, country/wave/form/module scope, routing predicate, member applicability, completion contract, response-role rules, and boundaries are governed semantics. Multi-column existence alone does not create joint authority.
trii_destination: Route A must compile joint-configuration authority separately from respondent incidence and preserve exact executable scope semantics before joint evidence is materialized/discovered.
chetiri_destination: Route B/C must load joint-configuration authority as governed sidecars before querying source respondents; source co-occurrence cannot invent semantic configuration membership.

concept_name: Same-respondent joint evidence is distinct from proposition equivalence
irreducible_obligation: Cross-source proposition equivalence cannot establish that the same respondent held/selected multiple items together; respondent-level joint configuration requires respondent-linked evidence and lawful risk-set/topology semantics.
trii_destination: Persistent substrate must retain sufficient respondent/event grain to answer certified joint queries exactly; compression allowed only under proved functional dependency.
chetiri_destination: Virtual/hybrid route must reproduce same-respondent joint evidence exactly from source-native records without materializing it permanently if performance/replay obligations are met.
required_proof_or_action: Use common hostile fixtures to prove exact joint co-occurrence, multiplicity, missingness/routing, and negative truth under all contenders.

irreducible_obligation: Certified joint packets may contain multiple question components; preserve component-level authority. Scalar packet projection is lawful only under complete matching and unanimous compatible non-empty component values for the projected field.
trii_destination: Route A must preserve component authority through any materialized joint/structural products; no row-level scalar flattening unless the unanimity rule is proved.
chetiri_destination: Route B/C must compute/preserve component vectors on demand and apply identical scalarization law; virtual execution does not weaken packet semantics.
required_proof_or_action: Reconcile recovered bridge v3.1 with current V551J/V552J/learned-world representation and add component-heterogeneity hostile tests.

trii_destination: Persistent route must preserve certification claims per component and not require relation denominators for context-only components.
chetiri_destination: Virtual/hybrid route must reproduce identical per-component certification/denominator requirements on demand.

trii_destination: Persistent route must encode lane identity in materialized handoffs/publications and prevent promotion by serialization/caching.
chetiri_destination: Virtual/hybrid route must preserve lane identity in computed results and any transient accelerators.
required_proof_or_action: Crosswalk historical lane tokens into current learned-world validation/publication statuses and hostile promotion tests.
